name: Independent TH17 replication of three-game PPO stage progress
allocation: Four isolated native instances. Four Hard and four Lunatic pairs per lane. Exactly two of four seeds per lane/rank play PPO first. Within-cell order generated by Python Random(1481700) in alpha, beta, gamma, delta order followed by Hard then Lunatic.
primary: Only the Hard paired mean difference in final observed native Stage 1 tick, three-ppo minus merged-sft. All sixteen registered Hard pairs count. Positive or null reported. For a stage transition use the last fully observed Stage 1 tick. No survival/event is inferred beyond native terminal. Stage triggers can also respond to kill speed.
inference: Two-sided exact randomization test of the single Hard endpoint at alpha=.05 under the sharp null, conditioning on two first-PPO assignments among four pairs on each lane. Enumerate all 6^4 permissible lane order allocations of the observed first-minus-second outcomes. Also report lane-stratified paired percentile bootstrap (20,000); other endpoints are descriptive.
secondary: Lunatic native Stage 1 end tick, first loss, Stage 2 reached and entry stock, last-playable bombs, remaining lives, and native bomb use in both ranks. Report per-arm and paired estimates. Fresh policy sampler seeds; original game RNG uncontrolled. Previous cohorts are excluded.
controls: Unassisted complete original TH17 0.01a Hard/Lunatic, no Continue. Same four-head camera, original clocks and physical lane within a pair. Prior diagnostic choices and trajectories do not enter the cohort.
scheduling: Each lane starts after its assigned 146 TRAIN credits. If the 146 comparison actor arrives, subsequent 148 credits on that lane wait for its assigned 146 HELD to finish. In-flight original games finish.
technical: Preserve diagnostic evidence for incomplete technical attempts and retry the identical seed on its assigned lane. Do not replace a qualified loss. No interim primary significance tests.
